description: This PHP source file defines the 'License' Data Transfer Object (DTO) class within the OrangeHRM project. It extends a normalizable DTO base class, uses traits for ORM support, and provides methods for serializing license information associated with an employee, including fetching related license details.

classes.name: License
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for employee license data, capable of normalizing and serializing license information, linked to an employee entity within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the License DTO with an optional employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the license data into an array format for specified fields, retrieving the employee's licenses.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to methods that retrieve corresponding license data.
